vetSays.line: A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." Company makes the road shorter.
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
🌱 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek looks over the garden: turned soil, nothing planted. Someone has to sow first.
📋 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek doesn't say a word. They just stand there, arms crossed, until you finish giving the order. The silence does the talking.
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with 10L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.
🪨 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek pries 2 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (2 stone now.)
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
📋 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek watches you give the order. "Interesting. Nobody asked me."
You give A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek 3 portions of Dried beans, with the village watching. They look at you differently now.
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek eyes the cistern — full to the brim. No sense hauling water there's no room for; they turn to the stone pile instead.
🪨 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek pries 2 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (4 stone now.)
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 50s, with thick glasses telling A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek about you. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.

🌿 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~4 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the stone pile instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪨 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek pries 2 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (5 stone now.)
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek folds their arms. "Sure. Your call. For now."
"Enough," A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek says. "I want a say in how this village runs. A real say."
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 20s, with a limp telling Mario about A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
You catch fragments by the fire — Farid telling A man, maybe 60s about A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
📓 Journal: Meera taught the person in their 30s, with a scarred cheek Wound Care.
"Why are YOU giving orders?" A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek doesn't raise their voice. That's worse.
📋 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
🪨 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek pries 2 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (7 stone now.)
👥 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek walks out with Mia. "Nobody walks alone today."
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek watches you give the order. "Interesting. Nobody asked me."
🛡️ Prabhjot, Mia, Farid, Elijah and Meera met them at the door — 5 put down. Prabhjot, Mia, Farid, Elijah, Meera are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Fritz, Prabhjot, Mia, Farid and Meera met them at the door — 5 put down. Fritz, Prabhjot, Mia, Farid, Meera are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Fritz just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
The Elder The Paparazzo falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder The Paparazzo!
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Fritz just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Fritz, Prabhjot, Mia, Farid and Elijah met them at the door — 5 put down. Fritz, Prabhjot, Mia, Farid, Elijah are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Elijah was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Farid taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.

Zoe has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Fireside lesson: Farid passes around Ground Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
